children: Oportun reported third-quarter revenue of $246.3 million, up 3% year over year, and net income of $22.9 million, compared with $5.2 million a year earlier. Adjusted diluted EPS was $0.51, up from $0.39. The company raised its full-year revenue and earnings outlook and lowered its expected credit-loss rate.
Total revenue rose 3% year over year to $246.3 million from $238.7 million.
GAAP net income was $22.9 million, compared with $5.2 million in the year-earlier quarter.
Adjusted net income increased 38% to $25.9 million from $18.8 million; adjusted diluted EPS was $0.51, compared with $0.39.
Increased to $56.5 million from $41.2 million a year earlier.
Oportun now expects 2026 revenue of $955 million to $960 million, adjusted EBITDA of $183 million to $188 million, and adjusted EPS of $1.60 to $1.70.
Third-quarter originations increased 12% year over year to $571.8 million, with returning unsecured members and secured personal loans growing by a combined 25%.
The annualized net charge-off rate declined to 10.6% from 11.8% a year earlier, while the 30-plus-day delinquency rate fell to 4.1% from 4.7%.
Oportun introduced Oportun Forward, a strategy focused on simplifying its core business, improving offers and the returning-member experience, and making operations more efficient.
The company said it expects originations growth toward the higher end of its mid-single-digit range for 2026 while maintaining a tight credit posture.

title: Oportun Returns to Revenue Growth, Raises 2026 Outlook
